# DMAIC QA Action Library (T6.2.1; generated by `python -m fda_recall.actions`)

> **Disclaimer:** Generic, hypothesis-level QA actions inferred from category-level patterns in public openFDA recall (enforcement) data. Not findings about any named firm, not regulatory or legal advice, and not a substitute for a site's own risk assessment. Built from openFDA data - not for clinical or regulatory decisions.

12 categories x 5 DMAIC phases = 60 actions. Data: `data/reference/qa_action_library.csv`.

**Citations.** `citation_verified = Y` means the section number and title were confirmed on 2026-11-17 on the Cornell LII mirror of the CFR (eCFR blocks automated access). The action text is a paraphrase, not regulatory text. Read at text level on 2026-11-17: 117.3 (definition of *correction*), 117.135(c) (types of preventive controls incl. food allergen and sanitation controls), 117.80(c)(8) ("adequate measures" against metal or other extraneous material), 117.165(a)(3) (environmental monitoring as verification), 211.113(a)-(b) (objectionable microorganisms; validation of aseptic and sterilization processes). Re-check on eCFR before quoting.

**Terminology.**
- *Correction* (21 CFR 117.3): fix the problem that occurred, without the actions of a corrective-action procedure.
- *Corrective action* (21 CFR 117.150): a procedure that also prevents recurrence and evaluates and controls affected food.
- *CAPA* (corrective and preventive action) is the drug-quality-system term used in ICH Q10 (UNVERIFIED here). This library uses "CAPA" only in the CGMP row.

## ALLERGEN

| Phase | Action | Owner | Example metric | Citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Define | Scope undeclared-allergen risk to label/formula changes and shared-line changeovers; list major allergens per current FDA list (verify list at time of use) | QA / Regulatory | Products with allergen-containing ingredients on shared lines (count) | [FALCPA of 2004 (FDA page; fetched in T1.1.1)](https://www.fda.gov/food/food-allergensgluten-free-guidance-documents-regulatory-information/food-allergen-labeling-and-consumer-protection-act-2004-falcpa) |
| Measure | Track label-vs-formula verification at each label change and at line start-up | QA | % label changes with documented label-formula check | [21 CFR 117.135 Preventive controls](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/117.135) |
| Analyze | Pareto label-related deviations by cause (wrong label stock, formula change, supplier ingredient change) | QA | Top-3 causes share of allergen deviations | [21 CFR 117.130 Hazard analysis](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/117.130) |
| Improve | Strengthen food allergen controls: label reconciliation at changeover, segregated label storage, supplier allergen statements | Operations / QA | Label-reconciliation exceptions per 100 changeovers | [21 CFR 117.135 Preventive controls](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/117.135) |
| Control | Verify allergen controls are implemented and effective (record review, periodic label audits); document corrections vs corrective actions | QA | Overdue verification records (count) | [21 CFR 117.165 Verification of implementation and effectiveness](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/117.165) |

|---|---|---|---|---|

| Control | Follow written procedures; record and justify deviations | All functions / QA | Unjustified deviations found in audits | [21 CFR 211.100 Written procedures; deviations](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/211.100) |
